page.content:
Gods of wealth and fertility, kin to Freyja and Freyr.

How Vanir connects

  • Character: Freyja — Freyja is a Vanir goddess dwelling with the Aesir.
  • Character: Freyr — Freyr is a Vanir lord of harvest who lives in Asgard's circle.
  • Faction: Aesir — The Vanir and Aesir made peace by exchanging hostages.

What is Vanir?

The Vanir, associated with Vanaheim, include Njord, Freyr, and Freyja. After the Aesir–Vanir war they live among the Aesir as exchanged kin.

Key threads lead to Freyja, Freyr and Aesir.
